0.why: GenScale.cpp:46 reads channels 0 to 11 of this input and switches each note on when that channel is above 1V
GenScale.cpp:69 sets this output's channel count from the menu setting; GenScale.cpp:66 writes one pitch per channel

comment: The twelve switches are stacked with the unison at the bottom and the major seventh at the top, GenScale.cpp:100, which reverses the parameter order against the panel. The scale is written once every 32 samples, GenScale.cpp:39. The maker spells the fifth interval Perfect Forth in its tooltip.
